P.name: Demon Shade
P.title: Template:Data Evelynn/Demon Shade
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Demon Shade|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Evelynn
|skill        = I
|icon         = Demon Shade.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} While [[Combat status|out of combat]], {{ci|Evelynn}} gains ''Demon Shade''.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} '''Evelynn''' rapidly {{tip|heals}} while she is {{as|at low health}}. After level 6, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Evelynn''' shrouds herself in ''Demon Shade'' after not performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}} for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Demon Shade'' immediately and places it on a 4-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}, reduced to {{fd|1.25}} seconds from casting ''{{ai|Last Caress|Evelynn}}''. Taking damage from {{tip|champion|champions}} or {{tip|turret|turrets}} interrupts ''Demon Shade'' and places it on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}.
|description2 = {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} While below {{as|{{sti|health|{{pplevel|250 to 590}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}} health}}}}, '''Evelynn''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pplevel|15 to 150|color=heal}} every second. From [[Experience (champion)|level]] 6 onward, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.
|customlabel  = Detection Radius
|custominfo   = 700
|static       =
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|spelleffects = 
|notes        = 
* ''Demon Shade'' is also placed on a {{fd|1.5}} second cooldown upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
* ''Demon Shade's'' cooldown incurs upon starting the attack windup of the basic attack and upon the cast time of the ability.
* ''Demon Shade'' activates even if '''Evelynn''' is {{si|Recall|Recalling}}.
* Upon '''Evelynn's''' transition into the stealth, ''Demon Shade'' will interrupt her in-progress cast commands for {{tip|unit-targeted}} spells, excluding ''{{ai|E|Evelynn}}'' and its ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}'' cast.
** If '''Evelynn's''' last issued order was to cast ''{{ai|E|Evelynn}}'', her transition into the stealth will be followed by an automatic command for casting the ability (if no other orders were issued in the meantime).
* Whenever ''Demon Shade'' activates, a puff of purple smoke will briefly appear around her.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
|yvideo       = 15Ha7pripXk
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Evelynn_Original_P_10.ogg}} ''"It's better in the dark."''
}}
